rule: Capture preserve invariants before repair; verify defect reduction and retained human value separately.
why: Technical continuity can improve while agency, curiosity and emotional force decline.
mechanism: Bounded repair protects the signature and meaningful control responses.
whenToUse: Any repair/refinement of a signature, capability system or agency-bearing artifact.
whenNotToUse: Do not preserve harmful behavior or use spectacle to excuse unreadability/accessibility failures.
parameters: Signature amplitude, capability differentiation, peak contrast, semantic behavior and emotional purpose.
dependencies: Before artifact/state evidence, explicit preserve invariants and separate Human Review.
implementationPattern: Capture before states and each named control response.
State the defect and choose the smallest repair hypothesis.
Capture matching after states and record defectReduced/valuePreserved with sources.
Keep original and refinement as separate evidence events.

goodExample.claim: FIR DE FOC Opus and LAMELLA show strong value with fewer, highly controlled effects.

antiExample.claim: Human Review preferred original VELORUM after continuity refinement reduced emotional force.

tests: Compare each control and signature peak before/after.
Ask Human Authority about impact, agency and UX Motion Quality independently of metrics.
repairStrategy: Restore lost semantic amplitude, state differentiation or curiosity trigger.
Retain improvements that repair concrete defects.
Stop low-information polishing and preserve unresolved contradictions.
cost: Requires comparison captures/review; no automatic post-processing.

provenance.claim: Candidate operationalization of existing human/technical experiment evidence; transfer unvalidated.
HEG/TEG specification and Human Authority boundary.

transferability: Observed context only; weaker-model and cross-domain transfer TO VALIDATE.
